description: Explain the observed effects of a confirmed transaction: status, fee, SOL balance changes, token balance changes, and named programs touched. This saves callers from joining pre/post balance arrays themselves. It does not claim to decode every instruction. Cost: 1 credit (0.0022 SOL). Example: {"signature":"<confirmed transaction signature>"}

network.description: Solana cluster to query. Use mainnet-beta for real assets or devnet for test data; defaults to mainnet-beta.

signature.description: Base58 signature of a confirmed Solana transaction, usually 88 characters.

name: explain_transaction_effects
